author: Tara Cahill
content:
We recently booked the soft play and celebration bouncy castle for our son’s first birthday. From the moment I first contacted Lopez at Dancing Cubs, he was so friendly and helpful. I had so many questions but he was always happy to answer them.
On the day of the party the items were delivered and set up exactly how we asked and collection was seamless.
Overall the whole experience was brilliant and could not fault them in any way. I will definitely be booking in again for future events.
